title: T1: validate team-scale capacity and guardrails
body: docs/SCALABILITY-SSOT.md T1 row and performance goals

decisions.note: HIL-approved material change for T1 design delta.
T1 design approved; staging cost envelope remains an explicit pre-implementation prerequisite.

brief.problem: PF has no validated enterprise capacity tiers or measured T1/T2 load envelope.
brief.what_adds: Capacity SSOT, T1-T4 targets, load evidence, and scale-out/in triggers.
brief.why: Prevents premature scale-out and unmeasured scale claims.

T1 guardrails are verified under load: RPM, concurrency, connection pool, timeouts, object limits, and tenant isolation
SLO dashboards/alerts and a backup/restore drill are exercised with recorded evidence
A capacity report with measured p50/p95/p99, errors, saturation, pool waits, queue depth, RPO/RTO is reviewed by HIL; no tier claim without evidence

BLOCKER: AC-1..AC-4 evidence is `docs/SCALABILITY-SSOT.md` (sha "candidate"); the SSOT holds targets, not measured p50/p95/p99, RPO/RTO, or HIL-review proof — AC-4's "no tier claim without evidence" cannot be satisfied by the declared evidence.

`controls.CTL-T1-CAPACITY.evidence` and `spec_pack.release_verification.evidence` both point to `engineering/benchmarks/BI-PF-1314/db/local/baseline.json` (a different item); the gate control would pass on unrelated evidence.

AC-3 (alert firing + backup/restore drill) and AC-4 (HIL review) are mapped only to `python -m pytest test-framework/tests/test_edp_t1_capacity.py`; no executable path produces restore-drill evidence or verifies HIL acceptance — declared tests cannot verify these ACs.
MAJOR: `coverage.runtime_capability` is `False` for AC-2/AC-3/AC-4 while still claiming entrypoint/tests; guardrail-under-load (AC-2) has no declared runtime capability.

`config_contract` pins only `PF_T1_TENANTS`; users/projects/runs/backlog (100/1k/10/1M) and guardrail knobs (RPM, concurrency, pool, timeouts, object limits) lack pinned keys, precedence, and invalid/empty behavior — checklist #8 incomplete.
`design_areas.security: N/A` contradicts `security_threat_model: APPLICABLE` and "RLS-enabled load"; no explicit statement that the benchmark role is not BYPASSRLS/superuser-inherited (checklist #3).

Open question "Staging owner/budget" is unresolved while AC-1..4 and the risk mitigation (HIL-approved cost envelope before load) depend on it — precondition for the capacity decision not closed at Gate 1.
Blast radius of the generator (1M synthetic rows, per-run destroy) has no stated bounds, dry-run mode, or guarantee that cleanup targets only seeded synthetic keys (checklist #4).
MINOR: Top-level `out_of_scope: ['Not specified.']` conflicts with the design's stated non_goals — inconsistent scope declaration.
No statement whether `scripts/dev/edp_t1_load.py` reuses the existing EDP-22/`backlog_db_bench.py` harness or duplicates it (checklist #10 reuse).
The harness's own failure diagnostics (logs/metrics to debug a failed run) are unspecified; only report outputs are listed (checklist #10).
`TENANT_ISOLATION_FAIL`/`CAPACITY_EVIDENCE_MISSING` are declared in the failure taxonomy but no test asserts their fail-closed behavior.
NIT: Top-level `rollback: 'Revert the change.'` conflicts with design rollback "Keep previous tier; do not claim T1 until accepted."
All `ac_evidence.sha` values are `"candidate"` — no digest pinned for any AC.
SUMMARY: Verdict: not approvable at Gate 1 as-is — the evidence chain is broken (SSOT doc and a prior item's baseline cited as proof) and AC-3/AC-4 have no executable verification path.
Top risks: unmeasured tier claim slipping through a control that reads BI-PF-1314 evidence; incomplete config contract for the T1 shape and guardrails; unresolved staging owner/budget precondition.
Language rule is satisfied (tooling/tests/docs Python); resolve evidence artifacts, security/RLS statements, and blast-radius bounds before Gate 1.5.

BLOCKER: `spec_pack.release_verification.evidence` still points to `engineering/benchmarks/BI-PF-1314/db/local/baseline.json` (a different item); only `controls` was repointed to BI-PF-1527 README — prior BLOCKER-2 disposition is wrong: release verification still passes on unrelated evidence.
MAJOR: `functional_spec.config_contract` still pins only `PF_T1_TENANTS` while `design_pack.config_contract` pins nine keys; both fields are in this delta but were left out of sync — prior config-contract MAJOR only half-fixed (checklist #8 contract sync).

`design_pack.open_questions` cleared to `[]` while `functional_spec.open_questions` and `review.reconciliation.open_questions` still carry "Staging owner/budget"; the cost/staging precondition for AC-1..4 was suppressed, not resolved — prior MAJOR disposition wrong.

AC-3/AC-4 verification still maps solely to `pytest test-framework/tests/test_edp_t1_capacity.py`; the delta adds an evidence pointer but no mechanism asserting alert firing, drill execution, or HIL sign-off — prior BLOCKER-3 disposition only partially addressed.
MINOR: `coverage.failure_cases` lists only "missing profile"/"missing evidence" for all ACs; `TENANT_ISOLATION_FAIL` and `SCALE_TRIGGER_NOT_MET` fail-closed paths have no mapped assertion — prior MINOR disposition not evidenced in the delta.

`ac_evidence` maps AC-1..AC-4 to one README with an identical sha; ensure the artifact records distinct, per-AC sections (profile, guardrails, drill, HIL review) with run ids so each AC is individually auditable.
`review.reviewed_by: "worker"` — impact review performed by the implementer; independent review/HIL loop not yet recorded, with COST CHECK still "new-path".
NIT: `functional_spec.rollback` ("Keep previous tier") omits the "do not claim T1 until accepted" clause present in design_pack/top-level rollback; align wording.
`functional_spec.data_lifecycle` ("created/destroyed per run") lacks the `pf-t1-` prefix, dry-run, and seeded-key cleanup bounds stated in `design_pack.data_lifecycle`; align the two rows.
SUMMARY: Delta genuinely fixes most prior findings (design_pack config keys, security APPLICABLE + non-BYPASSRLS statement, `runtime_capability: true`, scoped `out_of_scope`, reuse/diagnostics guardrails, pinned sha), but three dispositions are incomplete: BI-PF-1314 evidence survives in `spec_pack.release_verification`, `config_contract` is desynced between functional_spec and design_pack, and the staging cost/owner open question was cleared from design_pack without resolution. Top risks before Gate 1.5: gate control/verification pointing at wrong-item evidence, and an unclosed cost precondition presented as closed.

MAJOR: Delta added `design_pack.test_matrix` drill (AC-3) and HIL (AC-4) tests, but `functional_spec.requirements[FR-3/FR-4].verification` and all `traceability[].test` rows still map only to pytest — matching design rows not updated in the same delta (checklist #6/#8 contract sync).

`test_matrix` invokes `scripts/dev/edp_t1_restore_drill.py` and `scripts/dev/edp_t1_capacity_report.py`, neither declared in `affected_files` or `review_scope.files` — new test/control entry points outside the approved review scope.

`spec_pack.release_verification` and `nfr_slo`/`implementation_plan` evidence still cite `docs/SCALABILITY-SSOT.md`/runbooks while AC-3/AC-4 acceptance now hinges on restore-drill and HIL artifacts under `engineering/benchmarks/BI-PF-1527/` — evidence pointers not synchronized with the changed test matrix.
MINOR: Prior MINOR disposition wrong: `design_pack.coverage.failure_cases` unchanged — still only "missing profile"/"missing evidence" for all four ACs; no mapped assertion for `TENANT_ISOLATION_FAIL` or `SCALE_TRIGGER_NOT_MET` fail-closed paths.
Prior MINOR disposition wrong: `ac_evidence` still maps AC-1..AC-4 to one README with identical sha `d9956695`; no distinct per-AC sections/run-ids evidenced in the delta.

Prior MINOR disposition wrong: `review.reviewed_by` remains `"worker"` and COST CHECK verdict remains `"new-path"` — independent review and HIL cost-envelope approval not recorded despite the new "HIL approves cost envelope" decision.

`review.reconciliation.divergences` still carries "No measured T1 capacity report exists" while `open_questions` cleared to `[]` across all three fields — cost/staging precondition captured only as a decision, closure evidence absent.
NIT: Prior NIT dispositions wrong: `functional_spec.rollback` still omits "do not claim T1 until accepted" and `functional_spec.data_lifecycle` still lacks the `pf-t1-` prefix, dry-run, and seeded-key cleanup bounds stated in `design_pack`.
`spec_pack.implementation_plan.reason` contains a mojibake placeholder ("Harness ? load ? report ? HIL") in an otherwise finalized delta row.
SUMMARY: Delta correctly fixes the prior release-evidence blocker and nine-key config-contract sync, and adds real drill/HIL mechanisms for AC-3/AC-4 — but leaves FR verification/traceability rows, coverage failure cases, evidence shas, and reviewer independence unsynced, so several prior dispositions are not actually evidenced.
Top risks: test_matrix depends on undeclared scripts (scope drift), and HIL/cost-envelope approval remains unrecorded while open questions were cleared rather than closed with evidence.
